salivan_p21_5.why: EN "sky is the limit for you" is calqued word-for-word as «آسمان حد تو است», which no Persian speaker says (the idiom is «آسمان سقف توست» / «محدودیتی نداری»); «حد» here is the English word "limit" pasted in. The address also slips, "very intelligent dude" becoming «آدم خیلی باهوشی است» (third person) instead of speaking to him.
salivan_p21_5.fix: بدون شک خیلی باهوشی رفیق، آسمان سقف توست!!!
